verdict.rationale: Caveman Cloud exposes an API: there is a base-URL swap, and a probe found an OpenAPI spec at docs.caveman.so/openapi.json. So this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows API versioning or a documented deprecation policy. An OpenAPI spec on its own does not deliver the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
